item.title: The Geological Evidence of Non-Human Intelligence (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Johnny Tesone is a Colorado native, professional geologist, and graduate of the University of Wyoming, with more than 30 years of experience in senior and executive positions throughout the geoscience industry. Since 2020, Tesone has been investigating geological formations and ancient evidence that he believes point to repeated extraterrestrial invasion events and a non-human presence on Earth dating back long before humanity. Combining his field research with observations from the James Webb Space Telescope, Tesone challenges conventional interpretations of Earth's geological history and our planet's place in the universe.

His research forms the foundation of GeoVortex and his book, Secrets of the Winds: Discovery Chronicles of Earth's Galactic Odyssey. Available in English and Chinese, with an audiobook and additional translations planned, the book explores his theories about Earth's mysterious past and possible extraterrestrial influences. His work has also attracted media attention, including a profile in the International Business Times.

Spaced Out Radio is your nightly source for alternative information, starting at 9pm Pacific, 12am Eastern.  We broadcast LIVE every night.
